title: Harry Reid's request for SAP status denied by William Lynn

tellings.quote: Harry Reid was trying to get deputy secretary defense William Lynn to give us an sap and William Lyn denied his request

plain: In 2009, Senator Harry Reid asked William Lynn, then deputy secretary of defense, to make the Pentagon UFO study Eric W. Davis worked on a special access program, a tightly restricted classified program, and Lynn said no. Davis, a physicist who says he was part of the effort, tells Michels about the refusal and points to Reid's letter to Lynn. If true, it shows the study was refused the protected status its backers wanted.
